long_description:
Come enjoy an amazing relaxing evening surrounded by the soothing vibrations and positive energy. Sound baths are an incredible way to help soothe yourself from the inside out. With calming vibrations that help to stimulate the parasympathetic nervous system bringing you to a deep state of relaxation and allowing your body to tap into its individual healing power. You will experience instruments from all around the world from Tibetan bowls to Peruvian medicine drums, Island sticks, and all of the crystal instruments in between! You will walk away feeling relaxed and recalibrated.

Ryann Tillman: E-RYT 500 YACEP, Prenatal Yoga, Yin Yoga, Sound Healing

Every First Friday 6:30pm - 7:30pm

$30 per student 10% off for members
